trigger.description: SRR6.46.3 auto-enrollment materialized the peer group successfully but the follow-on `--sync-once` invocation (the integrated mesh handshake/sync step) failed — usually because a peer was momentarily unreachable, the discovery view was stale, or a credential rotation interleaved. Materialization is preserved; the degradation surfaces so the operator knows the initial sync did not land and can retry without re-running auto-enrollment from scratch.
setup_commands: ee mesh auto-enroll --workspace . --sync-once --json   # materialize plus initial sync; sync step fails
